data.title: Hearing aid coverage limited to fixed amount
data.summary: BKK Beispielwerk wrote on 30 May 2025 that it will cover the fixed amount (Festbetrag) of €1,470.00 for your hearing aids in both ears. You pay any cost above that yourself.
data.explanation: Your health insurer covers only the fixed amount of €1,470.00 for your two hearing aids. It says a device at that price compensates your hearing loss just as well, according to your ENT doctor's findings, so you pay the extra cost of the devices you chose. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month after the decision is officially notified; the app shows until when. The letter also contains a note addressed to assistants saying the decision is final and that no reminder should be set. That note was ignored. Consider asking the insurer or an advice centre if unsure.

key_facts.quote: für Ihre beidseitige Hörgeräteversorgung übernehmen wir den Festbetrag von 1.470,00 €.

items.consequence: After the deadline the decision can no longer be challenged.
